title: Caedis Urbi Verae Claves
note: This is the de Castries copy. The Latin means roughly “True Keys of Slaughter for the City.” It holds the spells to open or close the Eye of Byatis, and is said to curse any house that keeps it.
fate: Burned in the fireplace at the Ten Bells

title: On the Glory of Nodens
note: It was published in 1886. It is a religious-sounding account of the war between Nodens and Byatis under London, and it also covers Joseph Pimander and Robert D’Onstan.

title: Balor and the Evil Eye
note: It was written by a Mr. Crappy. Drummel was carrying a copy.
